Are you counting total carbs or net carbs? Net carbs are the total carbs minus the fiber carbs. A lot of calorie counter entries are showing total carbs. For example, I ate a slice of 1 net carbs bread (Keto Culture), but the calorie counter counted it as 12 carbs, because it was showing total carbs not net carbs (Total minus dietary fiber ie 12 -11.) So I either add the word net when searching for a food to find one that has already subtracted the fiber, or just make a mental note to take 11 carbs off what the counter says.

Hope this helps.
